review_details: Reviewer proposes runtime->gilstate.tstate_current on 3.10/3.11 and native TLS _Py_tss_tstate on 3.12+. CPython 3.11.9 PyEval_SaveThread swaps current state to NULL; 3.12.3 SaveThread calls SwapNoGIL(NULL), which clears _Py_tss_tstate. Thus current state is unavailable during GIL-released writes, and the global pointer may refer to another GIL holder. TLS ELF/ABI address calculation is build/architecture-specific, not simply subtract PT_TLS file offset. Bound-thread TSS and subinterpreters need separate validation.
